title: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform

creators.name: Phan, Binh Nguyen Lam
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Information Technology, University of Science, Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

creators.name: Nguyen, Thai Anh
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Information Technology, Van Lang School of Technology, Van Lang University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

description: ViAdminShift is a Vietnamese benchmark built from the administrative reform in force from 1 July 2025 (63 provinces merged into 34, districts abolished, 10,035 communes reorganized into 3,321). It contains the benchmark items (data version 2025-07-01), retrieval contexts, probing sets with the exact prompts, the model outputs behind every reported result, annotation sheets, scorers and analysis code. Data, outputs and annotations are CC BY-SA 4.0 (tiny-aya-global outputs CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; users of hosted-model outputs must also follow the providers' terms); code is MIT.
